claim_text: The president is seen in the days ahead looking skinnier in the face, as though he had lost fifty pounds.
quote: He looked like he lost 50 lbs
falsify_match: A visible weight loss of roughly fifty pounds in the president.
falsify_miss: His appearance stays as it was. Base rate: a weight change of some direction in an elderly man over a year is close to certain, so only the fifty pound figure makes this scoreable at all.

claim_text: After the January signing he sees oil derricks pumping and great oil wealth with wells opened up everywhere, and 2026 as a year of a fix running into May.
quote: I saw great oil wealth I'm talking wells opened up everywhere
falsify_match: A large American drilling expansion in 2026 with new wells opened at an unusual rate.
falsify_miss: Rig counts and new well permits stay flat or fall through 2026. Base rate: drill baby drill was already administration policy before this vision, so the direction was announced rather than foreseen.

claim_text: A changing of judges in the days ahead, repeated for emphasis and tied to federal harassment and to the courts getting more involved.
quote: I saw a changing of judges in the days ahead
falsify_match: An unusual wave of judicial departures or replacements on the federal bench.
falsify_miss: Judicial turnover stays at its normal rate. He gives no court, no name and no number, so almost any retirement would satisfy a loose reading.
